# proxmox_guest_firewall_ip_set (Resource)

Manages a QEMU/LXC firewall ipset through `/nodes/{node}/{guest}/{vmid}/firewall/ipset`. Guests must exist; PVE does not validate ipset references when deleting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_firewall_ip_set" "office" {
  node       = "pve-1"
  guest_type = "qemu"
  vmid       = 100
  name       = "office"
  comment    = "office networks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guest_type` (String) `qemu` or `lxc`. Changes require replacement.
- `name` (String) Stable ipset name. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node that runs the guest. Changes require replacement.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) IPSet comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<guest_type>/<vmid>/<name>` form.
